evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS carry the real gate. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 sets render=0.0 and constraints=0.0; both gate judge.toml files use aggregation='all_pass' with one binary criterion, and score.py:41 passes a gate only when its score > 0.0, so either gate failing zeroes the reward (score.py:48). Render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:23) is an auth+first-render gate with a negative and its positive control: 'An incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out ...; the correct password for a seeded Recruiter ... then signs in and shows a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' Constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23) is the backing/shared-storage gate: Recruiter creates a job (title, team, hiring manager, 2 places) and a candidate through ordinary UI, then 'In a new independent empty browser context sign in as the Observer ... find that same job and exactly one card for that candidate in Applied ... A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' gates/constraints/prompt.md:9 additionally says 'an API-only write does not count' and that 'A reload or a second tab of the same context is not independent'. This matches REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps' (successful operation + independent-context readback). Every gate leg is public: hireops_rules.md:27-32 (job has title, team, one hiring manager, 1-50 interview places; candidate has name/email/source; 'The card starts at the bottom of Applied'), roles table line 18 ('Observer | reads the board ...'), instruction.md:17 accounts/password. SCORED PROMPTS each restate an in-dimension hard-zero gate: functional/prompt.md:9-13 '## Global browser gate and independent scoring ... A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0' (all 43 functional criteria are type binary, so this is a complete zero); polish/prompt.md:9-12 '... gives binary0 throughout' (all 5 polish criteria binary); visual/prompt.md:9-12 '... gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' (all 5 visual criteria likert points=5). Each restated gate repeats the backing check (Recruiter UI create + independent-context Observer readback; 'A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails this check'), and sign-in is inherent in it, so auth and backing legs are present. No partial credit is assigned on gate failure in any scored prompt (the quality-checks.md #29 defect). SAME-ORIGIN: rg -i 'origin' over task/tests finds only two functional criterion texts ('the original successful move', 'original places'); no prompt or criterion requires same-origin, blocks CDN/off-origin assets, or inspects network hosts. The brief explicitly allows CDN browser assets (instruction.md:13) and nothing in the gates contradicts it. Request replays (functional/prompt.md:17) use 'page.evaluate fetch or context request' of a request the UI was seen to make - a replay mechanism, not an origin requirement. TOOL FEASIBILITY: the independent-context recipe depends on browser_run_code_unsafe; tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79) and the prompts also accept 'A supported separate-context tool'. Workspace evidence for the same pinned MCP command line (deliverables/ridgeline-print-storefront/oracle-live-2026-09-28/local-verification/browser/boundary-mcp-results.json, command 'playwright-mcp --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox', tool 'browser_run_code_unsafe') shows the tool is exposed; scripts/check_hireops_mcp.cjs asserts its presence. Golden behaviour behind the gate: raw-evidence-index artifacts (hashes re-verified) workspace.json reports passed=true for 'board: open a job, add candidates ...' and 'observer reads the board, conversations and activity', page_errors=[]. Counterexample probes: (a) broken app that might pass - localStorage-only SPA with sign-in: fails constraints gate (independent empty context sees nothing); static mock with hard-coded seed board: fails (new unique job/card absent); app that accepts any password: fails render gate negative leg; app with UI create but server no-op: fails. A server-backed app that loses data on restart can pass the gate, but that is correctly left to functional protocol D, not the gate. (b) conforming alternative that could fail - an app on a different internal API layout, with CDN fonts/scripts, drag-only plus button controls, or requiring a 'source' field the scored-gate text omits: all pass, since routes/labels are discovered by intent, CDN is not restricted, and the judge may fill any required field through ordinary UI. I found no conforming product the gate would wrongly zero. Minor observation (not a defect): task prompts drop the template sentence 'External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed and are not a failure'; no task prompt forbids them, and the brief allows them, so no same-origin pressure results. RISK=true solely because no configured judge run of the gates or of the in-dimension scored gates exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'); scripted golden observations are not judge execution, so golden gate passage and per-image browser_run_code_unsafe use under the real judge remain unmeasured.
